title: Pharmaceutical waste

review.classification: Original five-digit code, adjacent waste streams and medicinal goods were independently distinguished; the target is the expired material, not pharmacy services or disposal. Existing acarbose therapeutic tablets and bulk mupirocin are different substances, uses and gates.
review.primary_evidence: The two original studies support respectively the pharmacy route and the expired tablet state. Actual matched product, stock history, hazard determination, receiving custodian, event and independently measured whole-tablet mass are study inputs, and the audit occurrence percentage is not a mass ratio. The independent review corrected the unnecessary manufacturing-recipe requirement before the author commit.
review.measurement: Both language tables distinguish pre-release stock, segregated stock and external dispatch. Independent arithmetic probe in kg: 10 + 2 = 6 + 5 + 1 before designation; 2 + 5 + 1 returned = 4 + 3 dispatched + 1 other in segregated custody. The common 5 cancels across gates and remains the sole reference denominator; a subsequent dispatch or stock return adds no reference quantity. Distinct calibrated gross/tares or independent same-lot finished-tablet mass times count; packaging and active-ingredient measures are outside Q. Retain original cohort vectors, raw zero-release burdens and measured incremental services. Normative utility conversion is 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ.
review.native_records: Controller retrieved five pinned original public records, only three adopted conditionally in the bilingual cards. Archived mass/energy property and group chains support units. Finished waste reference, electricity provider and site-specific residuals remain unresolved; the candidate manifest declares these limitations explicitly.
review.readiness: Candidate/authored_methodology, English canonical and Chinese aligned, scientific and translation approvals pending. Metrological/site qualifications, upstream coverage, reference UUID and actual packaging BOM require study data. Scope acceptance does not publish a PCR or validate a site inventory.

sources.role: CPC3 row 1940, 39931, pharmaceutical waste and HS 3006.92 correspondence. Original June 2025 coordinate and denominator retained.
Chapter 30 Note 4(k) and subheading 3006.92 distinguish pharmaceuticals unfit for original use, including through expiry.
Irish pharmacy regulator, section 3.1.3, designation and physical segregation of waste medicines; distinct from off-site collection. Verify actual place/date rules and site practices.

Original four-pharmacy 2025 audit. Methods and Table 1 distinguish pharmacy stock from patient returns. Figure 3 shows expiry among recorded pharmacy-generated cases; Figure 4 illustrates designated waste. No named paracetamol lot, same-lot net mass or environmental coefficient is reported.
Original publisher abstract identifies expired paracetamol tablets. Supports only that physical product state. No common site, sample, formulation, custody or foreground quantity follows.
Attributional subdivision, physical causality and justified residual allocation hierarchy. The pharmacy custody balances are a method derivation.
